description: This file defines the QAppsClient class in the Aws\QApps namespace, extending AwsClient, and includes method annotations for interacting with the QApps service, such as managing QApps, library items, and sessions.

classes.name: QAppsClient
classes.description: Client class for interfacing with the QApps service, providing various methods for managing QS, library items, sessions, etc.

methods.name: associateLibraryItemReview
methods.description: Associates a review with a library item.

methods.name: associateLibraryItemReviewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a review with a library item.

methods.name: associateQAppWithUser
methods.description: Associates a QApp with a user.

methods.name: associateQAppWithUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a QApp with a user.

methods.name: createLibraryItemAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new library item.

methods.name: createPresignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a presigned URL for an S3 resource.

methods.name: describeQAppPermissionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes permissions of a QApp.

methods.name: disassociateLibraryItemReview
methods.description: Disassociates a review from a library item.

methods.name: disassociateLibraryItemReviewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a review from a library item.

methods.name: disassociateQAppFromUser
methods.description: Disassociates a QApp from a user.

methods.name: disassociateQAppFromUserAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates a QApp from a user.

methods.name: getLibraryItem
methods.description: Retrieves details of a library item.

methods.name: getQAppSessionMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a QApp session.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: predictQAppAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously predicts output for a QApp.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateLibraryItemMetadata
methods.description: Updates metadata of a library item.

methods.name: updateQAppSessionMetadata
methods.description: Updates metadata for a QApp session.
